services.desc: Explore San Diego fishing trip rates and book with a deposit. Choose from bay, local, offshore, or Coronado Island fishing charters. Reservations take a 50% deposit to book a trip. The other half of it can be paid the day of trip. We take Cash,Visa, Mastercard (Credit Cards require 3.5% processing fee). Prices do not included an optional gratuity for the crew (15-20%) All trips include Seeker Rods, Daiwa Saltist reels & Penn International trolling reels & any additional tackle that will be needed for each trip. Fish cleaning provided. We have everything you will need to have a great trip and

blurb: Founded in 2014 out of San Diego Harbor, Into The Depths Sportfishing LLC will provide a personalized San Diego fishing experience for anglers who desire to fish in small groups. We cater to seasoned fishermen or anglers who have never touched a rod and reel. Whatever your experience level is, you will have fun fishing and enjoy a friendly captain and crew while aboard.
